name: places-picker
title: Places Picker
description: Country, state and city in the reader's language, cascading so no query scans the world. Takes its language list as a prop, and its rows from any data layer.
author: shadcn-places
docs: Pass a `client` that speaks the shadcn-places contract — `createPlacesClient()` from `shadcn-places/client`, a service binding, or fifteen lines of fetch. Pass `locales` to offer your own languages rather than the 898 the service holds, and `countries`/`subdivisions`/`cities` to drive it from TanStack Query or any other data layer.
